changes.title: Amazon API Gateway announces API Portal
changes.detail: Today, Amazon API Gateway announces API Portal , a new feature that discovers, governs, and documents the APIs and AI endpoints behind Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancer, and Amazon CloudFront across your AWS organization. Many organizations can't see which APIs are running, which were never registered, which are no longer maintained, and which lack protection. API Portal builds a continuously updated inventory using AWS-side traffic logs and service configuration records, with nothing to install, no logs to forward, and no traffic to reroute, for a single account or your entire AWS

changes.title: RDS PostgreSQL now supports PostgreSQL 19.0 in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
changes.detail: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 19.0 is available in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment , allowing you to evaluate PostgreSQL 19.0 on Amazon RDS PostgreSQL. PostgreSQL 19.0 introduces the REPACK command with a CONCURRENTLY option, which removes table and index bloat with minimal locking. You can now enable parallel autovacuum for faster index vacuuming, and logical replication to synchronize sequence values to the subscriber. Two new extensions, pg_plan_advice and pg_stash_advice, let you guide query planner decisions. Refer to the PostgreSQL community announcement for more
